notes: Proposed review: accept the sampled projection decisions and all non-mission topic observations. Blocks 49, 52, and 53 perform a direct conversion appeal to the hearers. Their developed content is salvation, surrender, and Christian transformation; the sermon is not discussing evangelism, witness, missions, or disciple-making as a subject. Treating the speech act itself as mission would confound sermons that issue appeals with sermons about mission.
